name: Skin marker
note: Marks the incision before the knife.

name: Scalpel
note: Blade for skin and for sharp dissection.

name: Monopolar diathermy
note: Cuts and coagulates; the heat spreads to nearby tissue.

name: Bipolar forceps
note: Coagulates only between its tips, in short bursts.

name: Dissecting scissors
note: Divide fascia and tissue held between clamps.

name: Finger
note: Gentle digital retraction and blunt dissection.

name: Self-retaining retractor
note: Joll's type frame that holds the skin flaps apart.

name: Right-angled retractor
note: Hand-held retractor, repositioned as the field moves.

name: Haemostats
note: Artery forceps for clamping vessels and tissue.

name: Fine dissector
note: Mosquito forceps or pledget for teasing tissue apart.

name: Needle holder and suture
note: For oversewing and for closing in layers.

name: Suction drain
note: Closed drain brought out through a separate stab.

name: Harmonic scalpel
note: Ultrasonic shears that seal and divide vessels; they generate heat.
